reviews.text: Hello! Some may recognize me as I am DarkPasta who has partnered up with Targem Games. As the tester of the game during the early testing phase and also current early access user. I can say that this game has a potential. The reason for it is that the game is interesting. It kind of reminds me of terratech. I do enjoy the vibe that the game gives and I am a huge fan when it comes to apocalyptic sceneries and games themselves. Positives: The building is quite simple in this game and does not require much knowledge on it. The items that you can build or craft require resources. Resource management and getting them is also straight forward. You either find Scrap Piles, kill enemies, POI locations that have loot in them, some pieces of junk scattered around the wasteland. I will also add that the tutorial and journal section is a great addon for explaining the core mechanics with small videos and tips to get you going. Negatvies: The game could have slight polishes. Despite having a strong system, there are some stutters. Some of the missions seem to be bit boring and not too much depth to it (could be due to beginning being slow paced). Therefore I don't have much to say due to low playtime BUT once I get more time to it. I will update my review and give more detailed and honest feedback!

Buggy at times, won't let you unequip modules, you need to reload. Loading the game takes a painful amount of time for the size area. The game lags if you move with the map open (TAB). The minimap does not accuratly display locations. The lightning rod does not prevent damage to the surrounding area unless it is in the storm itself, making it useless. After a while the bots do not repair themselves, dispite a large clear area around the repair station. The game gets repetitive and you lack circuit boards. Your turrets don't do much damage or have decent range, but the enemy's turets do. Research takes a while, that's fine, but to speed it up you need more circuit boards, which you lack quickly. Storage seems low compared to the amount of resources needed to build things, even with a combined five storage facilities it seemed off. The combat is clunky and it is best to cheese by driving in circles like the enemy does.
建造冶炼厂需要合金，如何快速获得合金呢，建造冶炼厂。 随机出现的雷暴只对玩家有伤害，对敌方没伤害，明明都是一样的武器装备。 机械零件需求量极大，获得途径极少，后期极大限制了发展，纯浪费时间。 围墙靠近地图边缘时敌人会刷新在墙内。

想法很好的游戏，奈何BUG多得过分，炮台无故歇火、电线各种连不上导致地热发电成了摆设、单位之间互相卡位、明明是在念力塔范围拿起建筑却放不下来只能查看，极其影响体验！且很多过于基础的功能都藏在了升级树上，没点F1开启策略模式？那就享受战车超小的建造范围吧，而且每次点开建造模式都缩放都是最大。没点念力塔？那你就没法策略模式移动建筑，想动建筑只能手动开车过去，甚至念力塔的范围也小得不行。更别提各类采集设备和分配对应采集工作居然是分开升级的，你内容是有多贫乏连这都能分？？？总结不推荐现在入手，建议观望

操作设计稀烂，转向为了迎合不会开车的人导致车左右不分，毫无操作感。碰撞体积恶心，经常卡不拉的。前期各种卡资源，懒得玩到后期。背包操作系统稀烂。建造稀烂，每次建造都只有一扣扣视野给你造，调整巨难受。电力系统稀烂，电力串联延申巨难受，科技树系统稀烂，切割机刚开始不给你，强行恶心卡你资源。教程稀烂，刚开始如果错过补给就直接卡关。 总结，科技解锁纯浪费时间，建造一坨，操作一坨，指引一坨，流程进度数值一坨，背包仓库与资源消耗一坨。除了战斗还能玩玩游玩感受不到任何乐趣与成就感

去年一月加的愿望单，首发直接买的 只能说目前不值这个价格，油井的设计更是纯粹为了让你把大量机械分布在野外添加额外负担，明明旁边的矿床和化学废料都能用漫游车采集怎么油井就不行，自建油井的成本与数量限制也是难评 1号区的设置很明显是让你精铺的，但是2号区需要过滤器让你解锁并且大量制作过滤座舱之前没法在那边部署大量漫游车，此时问题就出现了，大冶炼厂在2区，小冶炼厂的效率一言难尽那么多合金炼到天荒地老，时不时刷新的野生掠夺者更是路过就给你机器来几下让你没法找个安全地方脱离炮塔铺生产 类RTS让玩家多线操作绝对是不应该出现的设计，这种设计没一个不招骂的，2号区遍地效率低得要死的破油井更是逆天，不喜欢玩一地油井就只能靠座舱发电省油。但是但是，*消音*的合金一块要2燃料！ 还是这个多线操作的问题，为什么不能提供一个让掠夺者不能在周围的地图边缘刷新的机器，这样至少还能在和另一个区之间建墙来避免多线操作，漫游车那个诡异的寻路根本没法让一个基地脱离人为监管运作，你见过两个建筑车都想修建筑然后卡一起吗，我见过好几次！在这种背景下不能单个大基地解决一切就是强迫多线操作的**设计！ 你游现在最该做的就是把除了地热发电机之外的机器全都改成通过漫游车模块操作不用拉线，这样至少还能组个武装车队去一起采矿拉矿，至少在野外环境下车的寻路和行为都还不错。 另外你一个非高精度美术的2D游戏76这个价格真不应该只有现在内容匮乏各种堆量和反复操作的线性流程，我只能说要不你改个移动基地出来做个围绕移动基地进行的沙盒模式吧，这游戏底子真更适合程序生成世界沙盒而不是线性流程，开头没有战术模式的手动操作更是毫无重玩价值。 真的很喜欢这种操作模式，但是流程和玩法循环现在是真的有各种各样的问题，这个线性流程和有限地图不知道的还以为你是EA版。 26.3.7 流程推进到火箭 实话说这段时间又发现了一些细节的问题，资源转换缺乏引导是真的，核废料这个刷新位置太缺乏引导了，很明显流程推进到核电站就应该有引导告诉玩家周围可能存在埋藏的核废料（实际上核废料基本上都不在核电厂区旁边就是，这个不太符合直觉，应该有核废料存储设施之类的场景建模提示玩家地下可能有核废料） 不过现在漫游车卡住的问题有得到改善，之前的bug也修复了一些（包括很明显的。近战怪对有护盾的漫游车无法产生伤害的问题）看得出来制作组确实想做好游戏。

Game was an interesting concept in the demo. I didn't get enough time with said demo to make an educated purchase, but I enjoyed what I did play of. I got into the game and I guess it just didn't click with me. There's large periods of time where you're just not... progressing at all. The clunky vehicle mechanics gets old pretty fast. You're often left wondering if your HP wasn't more than the enemies if they'd kill you first with how ♥♥♥♥♥♥ your guns are vs theirs. Not to mention you're basically surrounded by turrets and the only reason I could deal with one turret was the missiles I got from the forced boss fight raid on my base... that have a minute cooldown. I found it fun concept because base builder and you make units. I'm almost 2 hours into the game, lost one of my machines so lost a lot of circuit boards which is my main bottleneck right now. Said circuit boards are behind a bunch of enemy bases I can't crack because the turrets have screen wide range and will melt you if they hit you. Takes forever to kill them too.
I like the game. P.S. Tune your expectations. It's not an ExMachina return. Not the size of Crossout game. For the game made by about 5 people - it's a great game.

经过一段时间的游玩，既然在流程、资源和游戏卡顿上的问题已经有许多人说过了，那我说一些其它的操作的问题，发现如下BUG或可能改善游戏体验的方面： 1. 机器人寻路问题，多个机器人可能因为寻路卡死在同一个位置。 2.机器人自动工作效率极低，通常在反复转向和上文提到的寻路浪费大量时间。 3. ——（已修复）——决斗者自动射击装置上的武器在退出并重启游戏后，将直接消失，造成严重浪费！ 4. 战术模式下，有时无法在小地图上直接拖拽自己的视野，只能缓慢的移动过去。 5. 静止时，车辆的转向方向似乎是按照上一次移动最后停下的方向判定，应当默认静止时为正常前进的转向方向。 5. 如果车辆由于设计原因，采用其它车头，则气闸过滤器和赫菲斯托斯热能发电机将造成大量能源浪费。 对于气闸过滤器，除了车头，能否添加自动更换过滤器岗，或者在游戏后期添加永久过滤器？ 对于赫菲斯托斯热能发电机，除了车头，能否在游戏后期添加基于核科技的同位素热源？ 6. 车辆除了堆叠驼峰引擎或更换车头没有较好的提速手段，除了车头，能否在游戏中后期添加更强大的引擎？ 7. ——（已改进）——车辆在安装甲壳防护罩生成器后没有视觉体现，可能无法让玩家清晰的知道其效果（减免伤害？） 8. 在点出等离子生成科技后，由于没有很好的消耗等离子手段，其极度溢出，能否添加消耗手段，例如等离子发电机等。 9. 即使工厂位于明显的空地上，其有时候也会被标记为无法到达，然而此时车辆可以正常使用它们。 10. ——（已修复）——翻译错误，最终火箭电量需求应为250-500！ 出于鼓励原因先给个好评，期待改进发展。 ———————————————————— Note: The following content was translated using machine translation; some terms or phrasing may not be perfectly accurate. After playing for a while, since issues regarding progression, resources, and game stuttering have already been mentioned by many others, I would like to address some other operational issues. I have discovered the following bugs or areas where the gaming experience could be improved: 1. Robot pathfinding issues: Multiple robots can get stuck in the same position due to pathfinding errors. 2. Robot auto-work efficiency is extremely low, usually wasting a lot of time on repeated turning and the aforementioned pathfinding issues. 3. —— (Fixed) —— Weapons on the Duelist auto-firing device will disappear directly after exiting and restarting the game, causing a serious waste of resources! 4. In Tactical Mode, it is sometimes impossible to drag the view directly on the mini-map; you can only move there slowly. 5. When stationary, the steering direction of the vehicle seems to be determined by the direction it was facing when it last stopped. It should default to the normal forward-facing direction when stationary. 5. If the vehicle uses a different front end due to design reasons, the Airlock Filter and Hephaestus Thermal Generator will cause a significant waste of energy. Regarding the Airlock Filter: Besides the front end, could an auto-replace filter station be added, or a permanent filter be introduced in the late game? Regarding the Hephaestus Thermal Generator: Besides the front end, could a nuclear-tech-based isotope heat source be added in the late game? 6. Aside from stacking Hump Engines or changing the front end, there are no good means to increase vehicle speed. Could more powerful engines be added in the mid-to-late game? 7. —— (Improved) —— There is no visual representation after installing the Carapace Shield Generator, which may prevent players from clearly understanding its effect (damage reduction?). 8. After unlocking plasma generation technology, it overflows excessively because there are no good ways to consume it. Could consumption methods, such as plasma generators, be added? 9. Even when factories are located in obvious open spaces, they are sometimes marked as unreachable, yet vehicles can use them normally. 10. —— (Fixed) —— Translation error: the final rocket's power requirement should be 250-500! Giving a positive review for encouragement; looking forward to further improvements and development.

So, the game is pretty casual RTS, TD, RPG game. You ride your bots, equip them with weapons and fight with NPC. Beside the good UI/UX (that this game doesn't have btw), what would you expect from a slow game? Probably the answer is good progression. More you play - more content you get. But what if the progression was sluggish? You probably would want it speeding up. This game does not. I think the game have one goal - to outlive you, cause you will die of boreness or aging before you will finish this game.
We play as a bot, command other bots, build a base, fight off raiders and try to survive. It's beautiful, interesting, and there's a plot. We'll keep playing.

Building weird machines and watching them barely survive the wasteland chaos is actually pretty fun. It still feels a bit rough in places, but the core idea is interesting and kept me playing longer than I planned. Definitely worth a look if you like experimenting with mechanics.

I wanted to like this game but the gameplay has too many problems. The graphics are great and the beginning of the game is a lot of fun. Multiple issues aggrevate each other and make the end game a pain. 1) Every 10 days raiders will attack your colony. Often you also get skirmishers between that. You'll spend an incredible amount of time repairing stuff only to have the game throw more random attacks at you. Did you repair from the last raid? Now the game throws lightning at you and overpowers your lightning rods so you can spend time repairing after that. And now enemies spawn out of thin air in territory you controlled and you have to hunt them down before they destroy all your installations in the area because the new attackers have way more range than your defensive towers have. That also destroys that you're supposed to be able to tell your bots in what areas of the map they can work. That makes no sense when groups of enemies constantly appear out of thin air so your bots will get destroyed even if you try only assigning them to safe areas. 2) Bots are too stupid. You try to order them to avoid enemies and they'll still make sure that they get destroyed by enemies. You're supposed to have a fleet of bots. My end game ended with trying to manouvre two bots and trying to make coordinated attacks using those two - which keeps failing because it isn't possible to coordinate - the rest of the bots sit still. the storages overflowed ages ago and it doesn't make sense to expand the base since the current perimeter is somewhat defensible but expanding will just mean that the new site gets swamped by the repeating attackers or you can't fortify the new area due to a shortages of mechanisms. I hoped for a base with a lot of bots running around doing stuff and collecting resources, but something like day 40-100 was an increasing escalation of raids, storms, randomly appearing enemies, all in all it just ground you down. Right now I'm at day 270 and the strength of the enemy attack waves capped at something like day 120 but it was too much of a grind to get there and the enemy in the cold biome is incredibly well entrenched given the lack of intelligence and lack of control options you have with your own bots. Either the enemies will kill the bots, or the environment will, or low fuel will or something else. 3) It isn't possible to e.g. coordinate an attack with even two bots. It is possible to order one bot to follow another and it sort of works outside of combat. But in combat the secondary robot drives into the face of the enemy instead of using the range of its own guns so it'll get destroyed in an instant. So you have to rely on attacking with one bot only. I dreamt about a coordinated attack using something like five attack bots. But when two are this much trouble, more than that just isn't possbile. 4) "Idle bots will return to the bot factory or a sign that tells bots to park there". That sounds great in theory but it doesn't work when you're trying to coordinate an attack. I try coordinating an attack between two bots and while giving orders to one bot the other one drives away because it wants to go home to base. That's such a bad experience. Why is there no "stay" order? Exactly the same problem when you want to fuel two bots at the same time, one of them keeps driving away because an overriding order tells it to go back to the bot factory or that sign. And while you're doing a coordinated attack one bot runs off because it is injured so it wants to go back for repairs. I want to be able to lead a group of bots, not just one. And when a coordinated attack of two bots succeded due to very heavy micromanagement and many reloads, one bot begins running off again to run back to base because is a bit hurt and of course it takes the most dangerous route possible directly through and enemy base so it gets killed. You try controlling that bot, the other one begins making the same stunt. The graphics are great and the early game is fun. But there are some serious balancing and gameplay stuff that need fixing and the end game is a pain due to these issues. The devs are making patches but not sure that enough will be done to actually make the end game fun. At the moment I can't recommend the game.

[b]Too many things need manual control, too tedious than fun.[/b] For example, I cannot directly upgrade into Optimum cabin from a low tier cabin (due to only have 1 platform) So, I must first switch to a mid tier cabin (such as Simpleton) and expand into 2 platforms, then switch into Optimum cabin. Why is this a problem? Good question! To build a stupid Optimum bot - Method A: use Bot Factory >> build a bot body >> use Workbench >> change into mid tier cabin >> change into Optimum cabin - Method B: use Workbench >> build a Optimum cabin >> store it (you must first build Module Storage) >> use Bot Factory >> build using Bot blueprint Don't see the problem? Fine, let me spell it out, both methods are equally unnecessarily tedious! The tech upgrade (i.e. Module Storage) is there to just Uno reverse the same steps, giving false sense of automation! Even the Worker role is a tech upgrade and part of the gameplay. Yet, the Worker role is basically just help player to hold down and press the Space, since player still have to select which stuff to build, making it another fake automation. Finally, this game is no Early Access yet need much QoL and QA testing to be proper, which resulted in my negative review.

普通难度打通关上火箭了，随便说说问题 避免剧透影响初见体验整黑好了。 [spoiler] 1. 只在查看引导界面有暂停。无论是编辑很费时间的蓝图，阅读科技树，还是给车指派任务时间都是继续的。加个可选的时间暂停体验会好很多。蓝图界面没有时间暂停完全不如直接造个BOT，然后手动添模块再看情况加入蓝图，比如钻工因为资源溢出完全不需要第二辆，花时间搞蓝图不如拉个BOT现搭。 2. 敌人会刷新在地形上，甚至地形外。游玩过程中出现了，敌对的人类个体卡在房子里——全凭运气才能击杀；敌人的塔在坡上——只有一个很微妙的角度可以打到这根塔，在发现这个角度之前我用导弹磨了半血；以及定期进贡的敌人刷新在了左下角地图外——隔着边界的山能看到，但是只有导弹打得到。 3. 有专门拾荒的工种，但是没有捡模块回家的工种。控制的车炸了，如果你不想读档，就只能开个新车过来捡你刚刚爆出来的模块。反正不缺这点资源，还不如让模块丢地上，时间也是成本。 4. 我玩的不是最高难度，仅说普通难度的防守体验，高级塔全都是花架子。 4.1 高级塔的获取曲线非常不舒服。所有的高级塔都清一色需要合金，而合金财富自由需要油，而油财富自由需要油井，而油井财富自由需要铺防御保护不然一个进攻玩家的血压就满了。我把防御预设好之后等AI去造的过程本人就是在挂机的。 4.2 高级塔的强度和需求在普通难度没有拉开那么多。在实现合金自由之前，敌人是不等你的，这个阶段普通的塔已经拍很多了，而一直到我通关都没有更换塔的品种——不要合金的普通高个塔+普通墙。敌人不会一窝蜂一起进攻你的主基地，而是会散成漫天星，甚至还有撞墙不动了的。这同时导致难度降低（压力是一点一点拆开来的，不需要正面有特别强的防御力）以及打的很便秘（敌人卡墙或者路径就没打算来找主基地，但你的工人出门还是承担了风险，你得开车过去一个一个点杀）· 4.3 没打算挑战最高难度了，但是如果最高难度资源更少，那我也只可能尝试建造更多普通塔，高级塔更造不出来了。 5. 单个仓库容积太小了，后面就得一排一排继续造。制作组想的很好，加了一个‘资源入库限制’，比如废料获取溢出了，我禁止它被放进仓库，只在一个专门的仓库放，这样既不会缺少也不会爆仓。但是，跳提示的红点黄点非常烦人，不能关！而且只到游戏的尾声，玩家才能实现部分资源的无限获取，地图上的资源是有限的，我有时间把家扩建+仓库分开限制入库，远远不如我把仓库什么都不禁止，不够了再拍一排，资源有限意味着我的仓库只要足够大就可以装下整张地图，而不需要费心思去区分仓库。 6. 重点建筑在地图上的选取层级很有问题。到底谁需要在小地图上对电塔、墙、一大坨东西禁止建造允许建造啊，这些无意义的选取把最重要的‘天线’的选取挡住了！你必须把地图局部放大才能在一堆东西里找到你的天线（你问为什么是一堆东西？因为天线当然要造在一堆防御里啊，不然每次进攻怪顺手给你拆了），而如果你把地图局部放大，你的天线范围就很容易遮盖你当前的整个地图页面——这意味着你无法精确调整自己需要的天线范围。同时真正需要在地图上顺手调整一下允许与否的那些地图上自带的建筑，也会被你放在旁边的电塔挡住，你无法精确选取到（如果你电塔都不放一根，那你视野都没有更是没法选取）。 7. 运输的逻辑有点差，不会把临近的事情合并。地图自带的建筑，运输工运东西过去然后它不会顺便把之前生产的东西拿回来，而是去干优先级里的另一件事了。 8. 不明原因，某一辆车会自行解体。我的一辆车被我改装成建筑工之后，每隔一段时间就会把身上所有模块扔在固定位置，然后变回它被造出来时的出厂设置（蓝图里的样子）。最后解决方法是把这辆车拉出去送死了，它什么都干不了。 9. 车可以自由选择在哪一个天线范围行动，但是具体的某个天线造出来之后会默认加给所有车。开什么玩笑，后面我几十辆车，十几根天线，这时候我想区分能进右下角的车，和在雪地里工作的车，我需要一辆一辆车点。应该给天线端也加一个双向选择，允许哪一辆车使用这跟天线，这样就能区分不同区域的车了。理论上游戏的最高效率应该是把每隔区域的车分开，避免全部出门导致家门口的事情反而没车干，但一方面点起来非常非常麻烦（天线不能改名，我怎么记得住几十根天线对应什么英文，只能每次去看，起码让我能把它们改成 ‘左下角天线1号，右下角天线2号’吧。），另一方面你改这些东西的时候是没有暂停的，进攻怪压力还在那里呢，哪有空停下。 [/spoiler]

Going to keep this short and simple. I really want to like this game. That isn't some hollow platitude before a "but." That isn't a false start to make what I'm about to say after more palatable. I really do what to enjoy this game. It is cozy and relaxing. Enjoyable when its issues are not absolutely ruining the experience. When I say I want to enjoy this game, I mean this could be a solid teratech-like game if the issues were addressed. There are two issues this game faces. Firstly and most critically is the AI refuses to move your bots away from attackers. It's definition of avoidance is to move it slightly away, but still in range of the enemy's attack. This will lead to bot death that leads to bot death during huge waves that come every so many days. The second issue is that the economy can and will lead to dead ends, where you cannot advance, as you simply lack the material to do so. To compensate for this the waves bring in fresh materials, yet it is these same waves that will destroy vital machines needed for your economy to function. When it comes to bot loss, it is economically wiser to reload, rather than to rebuild. Were the AI smarter and more capable perhaps this issue could be mitigated. The AI is too dumb. I tried building an attack vehicle once. It died. The AI will drive bots into areas guarded by turrets resulting in their death or more realistically you cussing and reloading a save. The AI will drive bots up north to free and get wiped out, leading to another burst of swearing and another reload. The largest waves will absolutely wreck your economy with spam. This wouldn't be terrible if not for the AI killing your bots by not moving away from aggressors so you can deal with the wave. I hope these issues are fixed at some point. At this juncture, I've reached my breaking point with these issues. Two things could fix these issues. Have the AI move further away from enemies. Until they are out of range. Enemy bots should drop more resources to compensate for the damage they'll inflict onto your economy. This would avoid game ending moments and make waves a welcome replenishment of resources. In conclusion, this is a fun game with many good attributes, but it is dragged down by two major issues. Once fixed, I'd highly recommend the game.

The game left a positive impression on me. Game have good atmosphere, concept, and overall gameplay loop: exploration, base development, transport, automation, and defense all work well together. There is a real sense of depth, and the longer you play, the more you want to understand the mechanics and improve your base. Visually, the game is also pleasant, and the concept of post-apocalyptic survival with RTS elements feels very interesting. That said, there are still some things that keep it from being fully enjoyable. The main downside for me is base building. The idea itself is great, but the construction process feels rather inconvenient: the interface is not always clear, some actions require extra clicks, and rebuilding the base can become tiring. A separate pain point is demolishing structures. It is not implemented as conveniently as I would like, and the inability to properly remove already-built roads gets in the way a lot, especially when the base starts expanding and you want to redesign everything more neatly.

Edit: Initial review was negative, but I've since returned to the game post-1.1.2 patch and found most of my earlier complaints have been fixed, so I've re-written it. The dev is responsive and communicative and is actively working to make the game the best they can. Reward them for that and buy it. A solid vehicle sandbox/solo campaign action game with design tools that allow you to mix and match various parts to create any kind of vehicle you want. You'll start off with a dinky little single plink-gun thing and by the end of the game will be lumbering around in a behemoth with railguns and anti-missile point defense lasers, etc. Adding to all that is base building, automation mechanics, and defensive towers to fend off frequent attacks and this game basically ticks all my boxes. Easily worth the money I spent on it.

游戏有较大的潜力，我注意到地图有一定的随机性，后续如果能有自由模式那就很完美，游戏优化不足，单位变多的时候会有明显的卡顿，当前最严重的几个BUG：首先就是天线问题，既然设置了不同区域，就应该让每个工作单位能够遵循区域的限制，否则这些不同类型的车辆根本就没有意义，且会造成无端的损失。其次过多的逻辑导致了车辆行为混乱，特别是运输车，调度仓库显得完全没有存在的必要，建议让调度仓库或者其他方式自动收集附近生产设施生产的产品，并实现点对点的针对性运输设置，让运输车辆不再混乱。避雷针作为游戏中极为重要的建筑，它的影响范围不可见且太小了，无法有效的保护周围设施。最后，希望作者能够添加可对建筑废墟，障碍物（可刷新）造成破坏的武器或方式，因为这实在对强迫症患者太不友好了，当然游戏应该有它的特色，建筑废墟可以保留，但至少应该让玩家有办法去除那些可刷新的障碍物。建议将废料设置成可选择性的加工成所需要的部件，甚至增加成本也没有关系。

Good game that is plagued with bugs and annoying mechanics The goods: - Art style and visual is really good. The game looks great - The RTS portion of the game is fun and is quite different than traditional RTS. - The module system allows for fully customizable rovers. You can build many different rovers to fit each specific task - Fighting enemy waves was fun, the weapons all feel pretty good to use. - The story is decent. There are a few twists to it which are interesting enough to keep playing The bad: - Bugs. There are still many bugs that I encountered throughout my 30+ hrs of gameplay. From minor annoying bugs to major game breaking bug. Luckily the dev was very quick to response and was able to fix up my save file from a bug in less than 2hrs from when I message them - Bots are dumb. They often get themselves killed and I have to reload. For example, I add an antenna to extend the bot coverage. The antenna covers a small portion of the freezing biome. The bot then decided to venture there and quickly got frozen and got killed by enemy because they can't run away. They also get stuck every once in a while. They can't figure out the pathing and constantly bump into other bots or get blocked by other bots and can't move - At this point, a lot of environment objects cause all sort of headache from bot pathing to buildable areas. A tiny rock on the ground would prevent you from being able to build on top. And bots constantly get stuck around 'busy' preexisting structures full of walls and objects. The dev has said they will add more ability to remove objects in future update though - A lot of things in the game feels like they need better explanations. There were a lot of mechanics/buildings that aren't explained in the Journal/help menu. I often have to go look up to see others having the same questions. - The last biome feels way too difficult. You encounter these turrets that you cannot dodge. There are rocket towers that are just way too OP and I often have to position my bot so that they're the full monitor distant from the turrets or my anti rocket module can't shoot them down fast enough. You will get your bot damaged badly after every turret you fight and you either sit around and wait a couple minutes to repair, or drive back to base for repair. - The tactical RTS gameplay becomes possible with a rather late unlock (telekinesis). The game is way more fun after this unlock. Before that you're forced to do a lot of things manually which is just way too annoying. These issues below becomes less relevant after that upgrade: - The module system is fun but can also be annoying. With limited amount of power and space, you're often having to choose to build your bot for only 1 purpose. So if you're in the middle of fighting enemy and you want to repair a turret, you have to go back to base and swap out some modules. - Before the telekinesis unlock, you have to drive your bots everywhere which gets really annoying. You end up with multiple isolated bases and places you have to visit often with no way to fast travel between them so you spend an awful amount of time manual driving your bot to and from. Overall, for how much it cost, I would still recommend it if you can get it on sale. And if you play this game, remember to get that telekinesis upgrade
